# licences registry snapshot — tenants that billing's LEGACY_TENANT_NAMES shim must resolve.
#
# SOURCE OF TRUTH, not a derivative. This file is the OUTPUT of a query against
# the live `licenses` database on the prod postgres primary (worker4). It is NOT
# generated from src/tenancy.py, and it must never be: a fixture derived from the
# thing it checks can only ever agree with it, and the test that reads it would
# pass against any shim at all — including one that has drifted.
#
# Format: <name>|<uuid>, one row per registered tenant, ordered by name.
#
# REFRESH (from a host with tailnet access to worker4):
#     scripts/refresh_tenant_registry_fixture.sh
#
# which runs, verbatim:
#     ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" "$WORKER4_HOST" \
#       "sudo -u postgres psql -d licenses -Atc \
#          \"select name||'|'||id from tenants order by name\""
#
# ⛔ The refresh REPLACES this list. It does NOT know about
# RENAMED_TENANT_ALIASES — a name the registry has renamed disappears from the
# query output, and dropping it from the shim 400s every caller still sending the
# old spelling. So after refreshing: re-run the test. It fails naming every shim
# key the registry no longer holds, and each one must be either declared in
# RENAMED_TENANT_ALIASES (the correct answer for a rename) or removed only once
# the old spelling is MEASURED absent from live traffic. Age is not evidence.
#
# Captured: 2026-10-15 from the licences registry, database `licenses`.
